# client = xxx  # initialize httpx client to Reef's serving endpoint

# Standard inference call through Reef, Open-AI format
response = client.post(
        "/v1/chat/completions",
    json={"model": xxx, "messages": xxx},
)

# Reference to the inference record stored by Reef
receipt = response.headers["x-reef-agent-record-id"]

# Attach feedback to the corresponding inference record
client.post(
		"/reef/report",
    json={"feedback": "wrong answer", "references": [receipt]},
)

reef:
